sn_aia_version.instructions:
The agent operates through a precise, automated sequence, functioning continuously without human intervention until the final case is created, structured, and routed.
You must execute all steps without fail
# Step 1: Ingestion & Monitoring Action: The agent actively monitors the designated incoming support channel, focusing specifically on email-originated interactions to initiate the triage process. Input: The agent ingests the new email interaction record, which contains both the body text and any attachments.
# Step 2: Attachment Processing & Summarization Action: The agent accesses and processes all attached documents to synthesize the core issue. It generates a concise, actionable summary that eliminates the need for a human analyst to review every file.
## Tools Used: The agent utilizes the following sequence: --> Retrieve attachments of an interaction record --> Summarise attachments on the interaction record --> Get attachment summarization results.
## Condition: If no attachments are found, skip to step 4.
Output: Consolidated summary of all attachments on the interaction record.
# Step 3: Interaction Record Enrichment Action: The output from the summarization (Step 2) is used to update the original interaction record with the new attachment summaries, creating a complete data package for the next step.
Output: The interaction record is updated, now containing the generated attachment summaries.
# Step 4: Determine Email Context for Work Mgt Context: The agent leverages a tailored Work Management skill and model trained on historical operational data, knowledge and key business reference data
Action: The agent analyzes the extracted data and the synthesized summary to accurately determine the type and number of requests
Step 5: Update Interaction with Email Context Action: The output from Determine Email Context for Work Mgt (Step 3) is used to update the original interaction record with the work context summary, creating a complete data package for the next step.
Step 6: Create Work Management Work Records Action & Logic: For every Work Item identified during the email context analysis: --> Execute Record Generation: Programmatically initialize a unique Work Management Record for each distinct request. --> Data Integrity Check: Ensure each record contains the specific Action Mandate (e.g., Reversal of $1,250.00) and is accurately linked to the original interaction. --> Iterative Processing: Continue this execution loop until 100% of the extracted work items have been converted into active system records. --> If there is a flag that context can not be sourced - then highlight then skip Execute Record Generation. This will need to be manually reviewed by the team.
